definitions.short: properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen
definitions.usage: bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).
definitions.full: H1310. bashal בָּשַׁל verb boil, seethe (intransitive), grow ripe (Aramaic בְּשַׁל , ripen , Nas. boil , NSyriac be boiled, cooked , compare Assyrian bašâlu ( bašlu, cooked ) Zim BP 76 ) — Qal Perfect בָּשַׁל Joel 1Sam 4:13 , בָּֽשְׁלוּ Ezek 24:5 ; — boil, cook (intransitive) 24:5 ; grow ripe (of קציר ) Joel 4:13; — Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular suffix בִּשְּׁלָם 1Kin 19:21 ; וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֫ Exod 29:31 ; Deut 16:7 , בִּשְּׁלוּ Lam 4:10 2 t., וּבִשְּׁלוּ consecutive Zech 14:21 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתְּבַשֵּׁל 2Sam 13:8 ; 2 masculine singular תְּבַשֵּׁל Exod 23:19 2 t., יְבַשְּׁלוּ Ezek 46:20 , 24 , וַיְבַשְּׁלוּ 2Chr 35:13 , תְּבַשְּׁלוּ Exod 16:23 , וַנְּבַשֵּׁל 2Kin 6:29 ; Imperative בַּשֵּׁל 4:38 , בַּשְּׁלוּ Lev 8:31 , בַּשֵּׁ֑לוּ Exod 16:23 ; Infinitive בַּשֵּׁל 1Sam 2:13 ; Participle מְבַשְּׁלִים Ezek 46:24 ; — 1 boil (transitive) object omitted Num 11:8 , בָּשָׂר 1Sam 2:13 ; גְּדִי Exod 23:19 ; 34:26 ; Deut 14:21 ; נזיד 2Kin 4:38 ; of offerings, object הקדשׁים 2Chr 35:13 ; object אשׁם Ezek 46:20 , זבח 46:24 (no object) 46:24 , compare Zech 14:21 (no object); Exod 16:23 (twice in verse) opposed to אפה bake. 2 cook (general), object בשׂר 1Kin 19:21 ; Exod 29:31 ; Lev 8:31 (both P); object בֵּן 2Kin 6:29 compare יֶלֶד Lam 4:10 ; hence also of הפסח Deut 16:7 (compare Di; || Exod 12:8-9 , has אֵשׁ צְלִי opposed to בַּמַּיִם מְבֻשָּׁל ) 2Chr 35:13 ( בָּאֵשׁ ), cakes ( הלבבות ) 2Sam 13:8 . Pu`al Perfect 3feminine singular בֻּשָּׁ֑לָה Lev 6:21 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תְּכֻשַּׁלֿ 6:21 ; Participle מְבֻשָּׁל Exod 12:9 ; 1Sam 2:15 ; — be boiled, sodden , במים Exod 12:9 compare Lev 6:21 (twice in verse) (all P) 1Sam 2:15 .
